items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the space of a decent algebraic stack with quasi-compact inertia is sober (author proposition at source lines 10574-10579, label proposition-decent-sober). The proof (source lines 10581-10618) reduces to the reduced induced closed substack on an irreducible closed subset, which inherits decency and quasi-compact inertia, then to a dense open gerbe, and concludes by identifying the space of the gerbe with the space of a decent algebraic space, which is sober (proof lines 10581-10617). The two reductions and the identification of spaces are the substance. H3.
